name: Vampire - Shapechanger - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a feature

results.text: In a swirl of mist, the vampire dissolves into the night's embrace.
Wings burst forth, leathery and bat-like, carrying him into the moonlit sky.
A chill wind whispers through his form as he becomes one with the fog.
With a final shudder, his true shape melts away, leaving only shadow.
The air thickens around him as he transforms into a living nightmare.
